name: Flame Fruit
description: Transforms the user into living flame. Devastating AoE clears and a long-range fireball, balanced by mediocre sword combos.

abilities.name: Fire Fist
abilities.desc: Hurl a piercing column of flame in a straight line.

abilities.name: Flame Pillar
abilities.desc: Erupt a tall pillar of fire at your cursor that lingers and burns.

abilities.name: Phoenix Dash
abilities.desc: Stream forward as living flame, dealing tick damage on contact.

abilities.name: Hell's Crucible
abilities.desc: Detonate a wide explosion around you. Best opener after a stun.

abilities.name: Flight (Awakened)
abilities.desc: Glide on flame currents while above 50% energy.

tips: Open fights with X to zone, then Z while target is locked in the pillar.
Avoid using V at low energy — the cast time leaves you exposed.
Pair with Electro for the burn-shock ramp combo.

name: Ice Fruit
description: Freeze the air, the sea, and your enemies. Strong crowd control with a defensive ice wall.

abilities.name: Ice Lance
abilities.desc: Fire a quick freezing spear that briefly slows on hit.

abilities.name: Frozen Path
abilities.desc: Skate on a path of ice — high mobility, low damage.

abilities.name: Glacial Wall
abilities.desc: Raise a wall of ice in front of you. Blocks projectiles.

abilities.name: Absolute Zero
abilities.desc: Freeze every target in a wide radius for 1.5s.

tips: Use C to body-block ranged DPS while your team closes the gap.
V is a guaranteed setup for sword finishers.

name: Magma Fruit
description: Slow but absurdly heavy DPS. Magma applies a long burn that ticks through most defensive abilities.

abilities.name: Magma Fist
abilities.desc: Lob a slow molten orb that explodes on impact.

abilities.name: Eruption
abilities.desc: Pillars of magma rise across a small zone.

abilities.name: Hound's Howl
abilities.desc: Charge forward as a magma hound, burning targets through.

abilities.name: Meteor
abilities.desc: Call a meteor down on your cursor. Massive splash.

tips: Counter to Flame Fruit — magma burns through fire intangibility.

name: Light Fruit
description: Move at the speed of light. Hyper-mobile assassin with hitscan beams.

abilities.name: Light Beam
abilities.desc: Hitscan laser. Cannot be dodged at close range.

abilities.name: Yasakani
abilities.desc: Spray a cone of light bolts.

abilities.name: Lightspeed Kick
abilities.desc: Teleport-dash to your cursor and strike.

abilities.name: Sacred Yata
abilities.desc: Channel a wide laser sweep for 2s.

name: Dark Fruit
description: Suppresses enemy fruits on contact. The hard-counter to Logia spam.

abilities.name: Black Hole
abilities.desc: Pull enemies in a cone toward you.

abilities.name: Liberation
abilities.desc: Release stored matter as a damaging blast.

abilities.name: Grip
abilities.desc: Latch onto a target — disables their fruit briefly.

abilities.name: Annihilate
abilities.desc: Collapse a sphere of darkness around your cursor.

tips: C cancels enemy ultimates if you land it during their cast.

name: Rubber Fruit
description: Stretchy, bouncy combos. Low ceiling but excellent for new players learning M1 spacing.

abilities.name: Pistol
abilities.desc: Quick punch with extended reach.

abilities.name: Bazooka
abilities.desc: Two-handed launch that knocks targets back.

abilities.name: Gum Rocket
abilities.desc: Slingshot yourself to a wall or enemy.

abilities.name: Gear Surge
abilities.desc: Buff M1 damage and speed for 8s.

name: String Fruit
description: Puppet-master kit: pull, slice, and lock down with razor strings.

abilities.name: Slash Threads
abilities.desc: Whip strings outward in a wide arc.

abilities.name: Puppet
abilities.desc: Hook a target and reposition them toward you.

abilities.name: Cage
abilities.desc: Trap targets in a string box for 2s.

abilities.name: Birdcage
abilities.desc: Encircle the area in slowly contracting strings.

name: Sand Fruit
description: Drains stamina and bleeds water from anything you touch. Strong sustain on desert maps.

abilities.name: Desert Spear
abilities.desc: Compressed sand spear thrown forward.

abilities.name: Sandstorm
abilities.desc: Channel a tornado at your cursor.

abilities.name: Quicksand
abilities.desc: Convert ground into sand — slows enemies.

name: Rumble Fruit
description: Hitscan thunder strikes and a global ult. Mid-tier solo, top-tier in raids.

abilities.name: Thunder Bolt
abilities.desc: Strike a single target with lightning.

abilities.name: Storm Cloud
abilities.desc: Place a cloud that drops chained bolts.

abilities.name: Volt Step
abilities.desc: Teleport-dash a short distance.

abilities.name: 200 Million Volt
abilities.desc: Concentrated beam from above. Deals true damage.

name: Smoke Fruit
description: Beginner-friendly Logia. Easy intangibility and a long-range pull.

abilities.name: White Out
abilities.desc: Cone of smoke that briefly blinds.

abilities.name: Smoke Drag
abilities.desc: Tendril yanks one target toward you.

abilities.name: Smoke Glide
abilities.desc: Hover-dash on a smoke trail.

name: Phoenix Fruit
description: Hybrid healer/duelist. Flight, AoE healing flames, sustained DPS — rare and expensive.

abilities.name: Talon
abilities.desc: Diving slash that closes distance.

abilities.name: Healing Flame
abilities.desc: Pulse blue fire that heals allies.

abilities.name: Wing Storm
abilities.desc: Flap to launch wide feather blades.

abilities.name: Resurrection
abilities.desc: Revive once on death within 12s.

name: Buddha Fruit
description: Massive HP scaling and giant golden form. Walking siege piece.

abilities.name: Palm Strike
abilities.desc: Wide-arc shockwave palm.

abilities.name: Giant Form
abilities.desc: Grow huge for 10s — armor + damage.

abilities.name: Holy Lance
abilities.desc: Project a lance of light.
